description: This file appears to be a source code file implementing a hardware testing utility for a board. It includes functions for testing GPIO outputs, ADC channels, and provides a test mode with blinking and user interaction. It is part of the rusEfi project and includes code specific to embedded hardware testing.

methods.name: isBoardTestMode
methods.description: Returns whether the board test mode is active.

methods.name: printBoardTestState
methods.description: Prints the current state and pin configuration during the board test.

methods.name: initBoardTest
methods.description: Initializes and runs the board testing procedure, including blinking pins and ADC processing.
